```{r, include = FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy = TRUE, message=FALSE)

phys_char <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data", "LS_Physical_Characteristics.xlsx"))

```

```{r}
ggplot(phys_char, aes(x = Before_wet_mass_g)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5)

ggplot(phys_char, aes(x = Before_radius_mm)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5)
```

```{r}

phys_char_cleaned <- phys_char %>%
  filter(!ID %in% c("LS24", "LS47", "LS52", "LS35", "LS27", "LS50")) %>% #change with real data
  filter(Before_wet_mass_g > 1)  #change with real data

```

```{r}
ggplot(phys_char_cleaned, aes(x = Before_wet_mass_g)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3)

ggplot(phys_char_cleaned, aes(x = Before_radius_mm)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3)
```

```{r}

large_seastars <- phys_char_cleaned %>%
  arrange(desc(Before_radius_mm)) %>%
  head(n = 16)

small_seastars <- phys_char_cleaned  %>%
  arrange(desc(Before_radius_mm)) %>%
  tail(n = 16)

medium_seastars <- phys_char_cleaned  %>%
  filter(!ID %in% c(large_seastars$ID, small_seastars$ID))

```

```{r}

set.seed(98)
large_random <- sample(large_seastars$ID, 16, replace = FALSE)

set.seed(853)
medium_random <- sample(medium_seastars$ID, 32, replace = FALSE)

set.seed(54)
small_random <- sample(small_seastars$ID, 16, replace = FALSE)

```

```{r}

C10_fed_10meta <- c(large_random[1:2], medium_random[1:4], small_random[1:2])
set.seed(458)
C10_fed_10meta <- sample(C10_fed_10meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C10_fed_10meta_1stSamp <- C10_fed_10meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C10_fed_10meta_2ndSamp <- C10_fed_10meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C10_fed_15meta <- c(large_random[3:4], medium_random[5:8], small_random[3:4])
set.seed(75)
C10_fed_15meta <- sample(C10_fed_15meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C10_fed_15meta_1stSamp <- C10_fed_15meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C10_fed_15meta_2ndSamp <- C10_fed_15meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C10_unfed_10meta <- c(large_random[5:6], medium_random[9:12], small_random[5:6])
set.seed(567)
C10_unfed_10meta <- sample(C10_unfed_10meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C10_unfed_10meta_1stSamp <- C10_unfed_10meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C10_unfed_10meta_2ndSamp <- C10_unfed_10meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C10_unfed_15meta <- c(large_random[7:8], medium_random[13:16], small_random[7:8])
set.seed(32)
C10_unfed_15meta <- sample(C10_unfed_15meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C10_unfed_15meta_1stSamp <- C10_unfed_15meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C10_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp <- C10_unfed_15meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C15_fed_15meta  <- c(large_random[9:10], medium_random[17:20], small_random[9:10])
set.seed(7)
C15_fed_15meta <- sample(C15_fed_15meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C15_fed_15meta_1stSamp <- C15_fed_15meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C15_fed_15meta_2ndSamp <- C15_fed_15meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C15_fed_20meta <- c(large_random[11:12], medium_random[21:24], small_random[11:12])
set.seed(647)
C15_fed_20meta <- sample(C15_fed_20meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C15_fed_20meta_1stSamp <- C15_fed_20meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C15_fed_20meta_2ndSamp <- C15_fed_20meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C15_unfed_15meta <- c(large_random[13:14], medium_random[25:28], small_random[13:14])
set.seed(29)
C15_unfed_15meta <- sample(C15_unfed_15meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C15_unfed_15meta_1stSamp <- C15_unfed_15meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C15_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp <- C15_unfed_15meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

C15_unfed_20meta <- c(large_random[15:16], medium_random[29:32], small_random[15:16])
set.seed(875647)
C15_unfed_20meta <- sample(C15_unfed_20meta, 8, replace = FALSE)
C15_unfed_20meta_1stSamp <- C15_unfed_20meta[c(1,3,5,7)]
C15_unfed_20meta_2ndSamp <- C15_unfed_20meta[c(2,4,6,8)]

```

```{r}

sea_stars_assigned <- phys_char %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment_Code = case_when(
      ID %in% C10_fed_10meta_1stSamp ~ "C10_fed_10meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C10_fed_15meta_1stSamp ~ "C10_fed_15meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C10_unfed_10meta_1stSamp ~ "C10_unfed_10meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C10_unfed_15meta_1stSamp ~ "C10_unfed_15meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C15_fed_15meta_1stSamp ~ "C15_fed_15meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C15_fed_20meta_1stSamp ~ "C15_fed_20meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C15_unfed_15meta_1stSamp ~ "C15_unfed_15meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C15_unfed_20meta_1stSamp ~ "C15_unfed_20meta_1stSamp",
      ID %in% C10_fed_10meta_2ndSamp ~ "C10_fed_10meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C10_fed_15meta_2ndSamp ~ "C10_fed_15meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C10_unfed_10meta_2ndSamp ~ "C10_unfed_10meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C10_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp ~ "C10_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C15_fed_15meta_2ndSamp ~ "C15_fed_15meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C15_fed_20meta_2ndSamp ~ "C15_fed_20meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C15_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp ~ "C15_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp",
      ID %in% C15_unfed_20meta_2ndSamp ~ "C15_unfed_20meta_2ndSamp"
    ),
    Temp_Treatment = case_when(
      ID %in% c(C10_fed_10meta, C10_fed_15meta, C10_unfed_10meta, C10_unfed_15meta) ~ "Temp_10C",
      ID %in% c(C15_fed_15meta, C15_fed_20meta, C15_unfed_15meta, C15_unfed_20meta) ~ "Temp_15C"
    ),
    Food_Treatment = case_when(
      ID %in% c(C10_fed_10meta, C10_fed_15meta, C15_fed_15meta, C15_fed_20meta) ~ "fed",
      ID %in% c(C10_unfed_10meta, C10_unfed_15meta, C15_unfed_15meta, C15_unfed_20meta) ~ "unfed"
    ),
    Metabolic_Temp_Treatment = case_when(
      ID %in% c(C10_fed_10meta, C10_unfed_10meta) ~ "Meta_10C",
      ID %in% c(C10_fed_15meta, C10_unfed_15meta, C15_fed_15meta, C15_unfed_15meta) ~ "Meta_15C",
      ID %in% c(C15_fed_20meta, C15_unfed_20meta) ~ "Meta_20C"
    ),
    Sampling_Day_Treatment = case_when(
      ID %in% c(C10_fed_10meta_1stSamp, C10_fed_15meta_1stSamp, C10_unfed_10meta_1stSamp, 
                C10_unfed_15meta_1stSamp, C15_fed_15meta_1stSamp, C15_fed_20meta_1stSamp, 
                C15_unfed_15meta_1stSamp, C15_unfed_20meta_1stSamp) ~ "1st_Sampling",
      ID %in% c(C10_fed_10meta_2ndSamp, C10_fed_15meta_2ndSamp, C10_unfed_10meta_2ndSamp, 
                C10_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp, C15_fed_15meta_2ndSamp, C15_fed_20meta_2ndSamp, 
                C15_unfed_15meta_2ndSamp, C15_unfed_20meta_2ndSamp) ~ "2nd_Sampling"
    )
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, Treatment_Code, Temp_Treatment, Food_Treatment,
                Metabolic_Temp_Treatment, Sampling_Day_Treatment, Before_radius_mm,
                Before_wet_mass_g, After_radius_mm, After_wet_mass_g, Notes)

```
